headline: the bracket refutes "unique to block 47" for the SINGLE track and confirms it for the PAIR track. The pair factor appears only at 47; the single track degrades progressively from block 44.
pair_track: pair r stays 0.996-1.021 through block 46 and jumps to 1.1832 at 47. Minimum pair cos stays high throughout. That onset IS a step, and it is at the last block.
single_track: the single track's COSINE is the clean signal, and the onset is sharp at BLOCK 44: minimum single cos runs 0.9976 / 0.9995 / 0.9998 at blocks 40, 42, 43 and then 0.8438 at 44, 0.6812 at 45, 0.2888 at 46, 0.8172 at 47. Maximum single rel_l2 confirms it: 0.0702 / 0.0461 / 0.0209 at 40-43, then 0.5382 at 44 -- a 25x jump between 43 and 44. The single-track MEDIAN norm ratio hides this (1.0071 at block 44) because the deviations straddle 1.0, which is why the cosine is the statistic to read.
what_this_corrects: D39 and D40 said the per-track factor is 'unique to block 47' on six controls at 0, 8, 16, 23, 32, 40 -- all far from the end. With 42-46 filled in: the claim holds for the PAIR track, whose r sits 0.996-1.021 through block 46 and steps to 1.1832 only at 47. It does NOT hold for the single track, which breaks sharply at BLOCK 44. And the attn_pair_bias outlier was never special to 47 at all. My 'property of the LAST block' was right about one track of three claims.
honest_limit: the single-track statistics are over FIVE tensors per block (single_transition only), so a median is a weak estimate and I am reading the individual values and the cosines rather than leaning on it. The pair track has 41 tensors per block and its step at 47 is solid.
the_attn_pair_bias_outlier_is_NOT_progre: CORRECTED before publication: I first wrote that attn_pair_bias's max norm ratio ramps 1.425 -> 10.534 -> 32.556 at blocks 44, 46, 47. That cherry-picked three blocks. Across the whole bracket it reads 13.123 / 38.951 / 13.513 / 1.425 / 1.227 / 10.534 / 32.556 at blocks 40, 42, 43, 44, 45, 46, 47 -- with NO depth pattern, and BLOCK 42's 38.951 is LARGER than block 47's 32.556. So the campaign's famous 32.556 tensor is not special to block 47: attn_pair_bias carries large norm-ratio outliers at every block measured. Another instance of the worst tensor naming a tail rather than a locus.
